Question: With \(\$1000\) a rancher is to buy steers at \(\$25\) each and cows at \(\$26\) each. If the number of steers \(s\) and the number of cows \(c\) are both positive integers, then:

Choices.B: there are two solutions with \(s\) exceeding \(c\)
Choices.C: there are two solutions with \(c\) exceeding \(s\)
Choices.D: there is one solution with \(s\) exceeding \(c\)
Choices.E:
there is one solution with \(c\) exceeding
\(s\)
